name: Dusk light
description: Native PS5 homebrew port of Dusklight, a reverse-engineered reimplementation of a classic GameCube adventure. Uses Aurora and Dawn WebGPU with RADV Vulkan rendering, supports DualSense controls, save data, texture replacements and asset-only mods. Requires your own legally obtained GameCube disc image in ISO or CISO format; no game data is included.
author: Gary Riches
